name: moneymind-financial-agent
description: MoneyMind AI — real-time financial behavior analysis MCP server. Exposes live Neon DB tools for transaction analysis, behavior detection, budget coaching, and admin analytics.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Retrieve a user profile including name, email, monthly income, and monthly budget.

tools.name: get_monthly_stats
tools.description: Get current-month spending totals, transaction count, flagged count, and projected month-end spend.

tools.name: get_category_breakdown
tools.description: Get per-category spending totals and transaction counts over the last N days.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Retrieve the most recent transactions for a user, ordered by date descending.

tools.name: get_flagged_transactions
tools.description: Get flagged transactions — impulse buys and late-night purchases — for a user.

tools.name: get_weekly_spending
tools.description: Get weekly spending totals for the last 8 weeks for trend analysis.

tools.name: get_daily_spending
tools.description: Get day-by-day spending totals for the last N days to identify daily habits.

tools.name: get_behavior_insights
tools.description: Retrieve all AI-generated behavioral insights for a user (patterns, anomalies, trends, forecasts).

tools.name: create_transaction
tools.description: Insert a new transaction. Auto-flags as late-night if time is between 22:00–04:59.

tools.name: create_behavior_insight
tools.description: Save a new behavioral insight for a user — pattern, anomaly, trend, forecast, or positive.

tools.name: get_admin_overview
tools.description: Platform-wide aggregate statistics: total users, transactions, volume, and insight counts.

tools.name: get_admin_leaderboard
tools.description: Per-user spending leaderboard with transaction counts, flagged items, and insight counts.

tools.name: get_admin_flagged_report
tools.description: Full report of all flagged transactions across all users (latest 100).

tools.name: get_admin_spending_trend
tools.description: Platform-wide daily spending trend (total volume + flagged count) for the last N days.
